title: Cut Tools' dead code, mandate numbers and stale history
goal: CEO 2026-11-23: no dead code, leftovers or carried-over legacy in the Susi ecosystem; for all OS; agents only. Hook refusals cite rules by reason, not by retired mandate numbers; every home lookup works on Windows; commands and options nothing in the ecosystem calls are cut; README and ECOSYSTEM say what is true now; Susi Tools' own pushes run the public firewall.

reuse.searched: The compiler's dead-code lint over both programs and every test target (a binary crate reports an unused pub item, checked with a planted one); callers in Susi, Susi Core, their .githooks and docs, and the Board's 4,600 items for each command, option and setting; Susi's AGENTS.md for the rules the mandate numbers stood for; Susi's docs/agent-vault.md for what the last sweep kept for the Windows host; Susi Core's .githooks for how a public repository's push reaches its firewall.
reuse.reason: Removal and rewording only, plus a one-line pre-push hook that calls the existing susi-tools hook pre-push; nothing new is built.
